flags.message: codex-baseline, claude-baseline, and gemini-baseline each freeze band baseline under sal-v3 for Term 2026, but the committed metrics/statpack.md salience-band table is sal-v4. Per the evaluation contract, all three evaluations omit segment_base_rate and brier_skill_score and leave base_rate_basis null. A terminal fallback cannot repair a version mismatch for a frozen band. Correctness and Brier scores remain assessable; the candidate-specific evaluation.md files document this baseline limitation.
